propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys (LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO) that do not exist in live Jira, causing jql_active queries to fail with parse errors.

The fetcher._build_snapshot multi-project fan-out iterates every key in projects.json and issues a JQL query per project; the first nonexistent key LEG causes ACLI to reject the query and abort the entire reconcile pass.

The .bridge_state/projects.json write path (projects_store.set_project/remove_project → _write_record) lacks write locking, commit, and push semantics, permitting ad-hoc git commits that corrupted the live state.

Restoration of .bridge_state/projects.json to the canonical single-project state (legacy_default: REB, projects: {}) with empty projects dict causes the fan-out to fall back to the default project and eliminates the JQL parse error.
